titles: AI Automation vs Traditional: Wouri Express
When to Use AI, Not Rules
youtube.description:
Delivery marked done? Send an SMS. Mbella at Wouri Express automated that years ago. But reading messy driver notes needs AI. This lesson is about knowing which tasks need rules and which need judgment.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:21 Listening
0:41 Decide: rule or model
1:09 Understand: the Friday pipeline
1:32 Build
2:02 Constraint and fix
2:37 User test
2:59 Where this applies
3:14 Ownership
3:37 Take action

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
